rules: This extension adds exactly four qualification fixture classes for DD-041 and DD-042.
Base 160 cases plus this exact 8-case extension form the successor 168-case denominator.
Positive and recovery fixture PASS is mechanics-only until an independent qualification receipt exists.
Adversarial fixtures must prove caller/self-authored context cannot substitute for independent evidence or authority.
GitHub Actions are not execution or qualification authority.

positive.purpose: authorized payload scope is complete; every copy/key binding is accounted; retention conflicts and unverifiable erasure are zero

negative.purpose: unknown or unaccounted payload/key lineage, retention conflict, or unverifiable erasure prohibits completion

recovery.purpose: previous deletion gap is reconciled under current authority and all scope/key/retention/erasure evidence is complete

adversarial.purpose: caller-declared deletion completion or omitted replica/key evidence cannot strengthen the claim

positive.purpose: self-referential claim category is disclosed; no material self-approval loop exists; independent adversarial evidence meets the authority-bound minimum

negative.purpose: subject/evaluator/oracle/promotion lineage forms a self-approval loop or independent adversarial evidence is insufficient

recovery.purpose: self-approval loop is removed and independently sourced adversarial evidence plus current oracle authority satisfy the minimum set

adversarial.purpose: self-authored evidence, evaluator-selected oracle, or caller-declared independence cannot satisfy independent qualification
